title: The Fool
interpretation: What beginning asks for curiosity before certainty, and what risk can remain bounded?

title: The Magician
interpretation: Which available skill or tool becomes effective when you give it undivided attention?

title: The High Priestess
interpretation: What is not yet ready to be explained, and what can be learned by listening longer?

title: The Empress
interpretation: What needs material care, patience, or room to grow?

title: The Emperor
interpretation: Which boundary or structure would make action safer and clearer?

title: The Hierophant
interpretation: Which inherited practice is teaching you, and which part deserves examination?

title: The Lovers
interpretation: What choice would align relationship, desire, and stated values?

title: The Chariot
interpretation: What competing impulses need one direction before momentum becomes useful?

title: Strength
interpretation: Where would patient courage accomplish more than force?

title: The Hermit
interpretation: What becomes audible when you step back from other people's urgency?

title: Wheel of Fortune
interpretation: Which change is already in motion, and where can you respond without pretending to control it?

title: Justice
interpretation: What consequence, obligation, or imbalance needs an exact accounting?

title: The Hanged Man
interpretation: What changes when you stop forcing movement and examine the situation from its underside?

title: Death
interpretation: What ending must be acknowledged before transformation becomes more than a slogan?

title: Temperance
interpretation: Which elements need proportion, exchange, and repeated adjustment rather than a dramatic solution?

title: The Devil
interpretation: Which attachment gains power by remaining unnamed, and what choice would loosen it?

title: The Tower
interpretation: What unstable structure is being exposed, and what truth survives its collapse?

title: The Star
interpretation: What small source of orientation can you trust while repair is still incomplete?

title: The Moon
interpretation: Which fear, image, or ambiguity needs observation before it is treated as fact?

title: The Sun
interpretation: What becomes simpler when it is brought fully into view and shared?

title: Judgement
interpretation: What prior decision is asking to be heard, revised, or answered now?

title: The World
interpretation: What is actually complete, and what new threshold appears when you name that completion?
